   "source": [
    "# 声音"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "683662b5",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from scipy.fftpack import fft, fftfreq\n",
    "\n",
    "# 计算 FFT\n",
    "fft_values = fft(data)\n",
    "frequencies = fftfreq(len(data), d=1/rate)  # 计算频率轴\n",
    "\n",
    "# 画出频谱（只看正频部分）\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "plt.plot(frequencies[:len(frequencies)//2], np.abs(fft_values[:len(frequencies)//2]))\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Frequency (Hz)\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Magnitude\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Frequency Spectrum of Audio\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "27808c6a-3ab7-4290-aff5-6a0f7af7ba9c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "filtered_fft = np.zeros_like(fft_values)\n",
    "filtered_fft[(frequencies > 300) & (frequencies <600)] = fft_values[(frequencies > 300) & (frequencies < 600)]\n",
    "\n",
    "# 逆变换回时域\n",
    "filtered_signal = np.real(np.fft.ifft(filtered_fft))\n",
    "\n",
    "# 画出分离后的信号波形\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "plt.plot(np.linspace(0, len(data)/rate, len(data)), filtered_signal)\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Time (s)\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Extracted Frequency Components (300Hz - 600Hz)\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
